title: LuckyLogin
description: LuckyLogin - reward players for joining your server!
body:
## ☘️ **LuckyLogin - reward your players!**

**LuckyLogin** is a fully configurable plugin that adds rewards for just joining to your server. You can add multiple reward types, cooldown, broadcast and more!

## ✨ Features

- 🎲 **Weighted random rewards** — control drop chances via `weight`
- 📦 **8 reward types** — item, command, message, money, exp, effect, title, multi
- ⏱️ **Cooldown system** — configurable cooldown (default 24h)
- 📢 **Broadcast** — announce rewards to the whole server
- 🔊 **Sound on reward** — customize reward sound
- 💰 **Vault support** — money rewards via any Economy plugin

## 📋 Reward Types

- | `item` | Any item with custom name, lore and enchantments |
- | `command` | Any command you want (`%player%` placeholder) |
- | `message` | Colored chat message |
- | `money` | Money via Vault Economy |
- | `exp` | Experience points or levels |
- | `effect` | Potion effect with duration and amplifier |
- | `title` | Title + subtitle with custom timing |
- | `multi` | Combination of multiple reward types at once |

## 💬 Commands

- | `/ll reload` | Reload config & messages |
- | `/ll info` | Plugin information |
- | `/ll list` | List all rewards with chances |
- | `/ll give <player> <id>` | Manually give a reward |

## 🔒 Permissions

- | `luckylogin.admin` | Admin Commands (default: OP) |
- | `luckylogin.bypass` | Bypass cooldown |

## ⚙️ Requirements

- **Paper** 26.1.2+ (it can also work on older vesions but it was tested only on 26.1.2)
- **Java** 25+ (requirement for 26.1.2)
- **Vault** *(optional, for money rewards)*

## 🤖 Note

This plugin was developed with **Claude AI**.
All code has been reviewed, tested and is fully functional.
If you find any bugs, please dm me on discord: arnold0322.

## 📁 Configuration

All rewards, cooldowns, messages and sounds are configurable via:
- `config.yml` — rewards, cooldown, sound, broadcast
- `messages.yml` — all plugin messages with color code support
